description: Contains Details of all shifts of the year, includes shift number, day number, week number, month number, Shift type

columns.name: wds_week_no
columns.description: week number of the shift. Starts from 1 for every year

columns.name: wds_month_no
columns.description: month number of the shift. Starts from 1 for every year

columns.name: wds_day_no
columns.description: day number of the shift. Starts from 1 for every year

columns.name: wds_shift_no
columns.description: shift number of the shift. Starts from 1 for every year

columns.name: wds_shift_type
columns.description: Shift type of the shift. M - Morning shift; A - Afternoon shift; N - Night shift
